name: Saskatchewan
summary: Green over gold horizontal halves with the provincial shield in the upper hoist and a western red lily in the fly. Designed by Anthony Drake, it won a competition with over 4,000 entries.
origin: A provincial competition in 1968 drew more than 4,000 entries. Anthony Drake, a teacher, submitted the winning design, which was adopted on 22 September 1969.

colors.name: Red
colors.meaning: The lily and the shield's lion.

symbols.name: Western red lily
symbols.description: A red lily in the fly.

symbols.name: Shield
symbols.description: A red lion under St George's Cross, above three wheat sheaves on green.

facts: Its green and gold are also the colours of the Saskatchewan Roughriders football team.
More than 4,000 designs were submitted to the competition.
The western red lily is a protected species in the province.
clues: Green over gold with a shield at the hoist and a red lily in the fly.
Its halves are northern forest and southern grain.
Chosen from over 4,000 entries in a 1968 competition.
